October 25, 2026 • Updated November 21, 2026 • By Faospark • Project Direction An important update on the future architecture, scope, and direction of Project Kyaro : why continuing to pile endless features into a single suite is no longer sustainable, how the mod will be reorganized into thematic packages, and what to expect next. items.text: Alright, okay. Let me get this off my chest. I'm mostly writing this down as a way to log something that happened in the past regarding Project Kyaro . I think it's been over a year now since I watched a video from a fairly popular content creator criticizing the project. To be clear, it doesn't really bother me anymore. Looking back, I actually understand a lot of the criticism. What many people didn't understand at the time, though, was how the project was being made and the limitations I was working with. Back then, Project Kyaro wasn't a BepInEx plugin yet. I was using Special K, which was far from the ideal setup for retexturing the game. Unlike today, I didn't have direct access to all the sprite assets. I had to capture them as they appeared during gameplay. That meant rushing through both games, trying to encounter and capture as many sprites as possible. If I missed a sprite in a specific scene, there was a good chance I wouldn't see it again for quite some time.
